description: Did this USDC transfer settle to the expected address and amount? Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 at $0.001 USDC. Same resource URL as the REST route.

amount.description: Atomic USDC amount: 1 to 30 digits, no leading zeros. Exactly one of amount or amountUsd is required.

amountUsd.description: Decimal USDC amount: up to 12 digits before the point and up to 6 after. Exactly one of amount or amountUsd is required.

asset.description: USDC (case-insensitive) or the USDC contract address for the selected network. Omit to default to USDC.

network.description: CAIP-2 of the live settlement network. Omit or send empty to use the configured default. A non-empty value must equal the schema enum exactly.

tx.description: Alias of txHash. Same 0x-prefixed 64-hex format. If both are sent they must match case-insensitively.

txHash.description: 0x-prefixed 64-hex-character transaction hash. Required by the validator (tx is an accepted alias).

name: verify_receipt
